title: رئيس الاتحاد الإسباني يتحدى المغاربة بتصريح حاسم: لا تفاوض
summary: عاد رئيس الاتحاد الإسباني لكرة القدم، رافائيل لوزان، للحديث عن الجدل الدائر بشأن الملعب الذي سيستضيف نهائي كأس العالم 2030، التي ستنظمها إسبانيا إلى جانب البرتغال والمغرب.

Stuart Ashen—better known by his YouTube persona Ashens—grew up on a diet of 8-bit games on consoles like the Atari 2600 and the Spectrum. The earliest PC game he recalls playing was Syndicate Wars on his first home-built rig—a Pentium 200 MMX machine housed in a server tower case: "I loved Syndicate . Hated Syndicate Wars. I decided to hop into the beta branch myself and take her for a whirl, and—yeah, those changes'll have to come. The Fool's central mechanic is her bow and arrow—she can fire an arrow/shoot card to deal damage equal to the card's base damage plus her aim. So if a shoot card deals 15 damage and she has six aim stocked, she'll deal 21. This is a little busted, because by default, the Fool has 6 aim already put in her bank. Her non-strike starter card, Foolish Shot, already deals a hefty 15 damage for just one energy. The offline function arrived in an otherwise unremarkable patch that mainly fixes specific bugs and technical issues. "It's not possible to play the game in single-player mode without requiring an Internet connection at any point," Funcom revealed in a Steam post. This includes "creating and deleting single-player characters." Dune: Awakening has been gradually drifting away from being a purely multiplayer experience for some time. In April, Funcom made its PvP element, like the Deep Desert and shipwreck exploration, fully optional . A fully fledged single-player mode arrived in September, including a dramatic rework of several major endgame systems—like its dynamic political "Landsraad" system' to make them work in solo play. body: In late October, Chronicles: Medieval developer Raw Power Games announced that it was in trouble . Funding for its ambitious, historical sandbox strategy had suddenly been pulled, and as a result the studio was at "real risk of closing". But it turns out the situation was even more dire than the announcement suggested, as Raw Power Games declared bankruptcy on the same day. Despite this, development of Chronicles: Medieval will continue with at least some of its original creators involved, after Satisfactory developers Coffee Stain swooped in to purchase the assets and IP. In a press release , Coffee Stain said that it submitted the winning bid in Raw Power's sale process following the company's bankruptcy, paying 36.75 million Danish Krone (around $5.42 million) for Chronicles: Medieval's intellectual property. Rather than acquire the assets directly, however, Coffee Stain will transfer them directly to a "newly established company" that is owned 75% by Coffee Stain, and 25% by "a small group of key members of the game's original development team." "I mean we do a ton [of testing] internally, but then as games get greenlit, we'll bring in external groups," Bilder told PC Gamer associate editor Ted Litchfield in a recent interview. "We want to make sure that we're not just local-biased with our own opinions on things. We want to make sure these games are playing well." body: Use of generative AI remains one of the most contentious topics in the games industry. Developers who see a bright new future in the tech have increasingly clashed with those concerned by the ethical , artistic , and labour implications tools like ChatGPT and Claude Opus bring to the medium. The divisive nature of the subject was starkly revealed in a new report, which calculated that 40% of game developers are actively using generative AI, while more than half of developers believe LLMs and agentic coding tools have a negative impact on the industry. These were the conclusions of the latest State of the Game Industry report from the Game Developer's Conference (via Eurogamer ). body: Doom developer id Software has confirmed that it's working on a new game, although in phrasing that might strike you as familiar, it'll be "some time" before it's ready to reveal anything. The new project at id was first announced by Xbox CEO Asha Sharma, who's been making a few posts on X today to mark the looming 25 th anniversary of the original Xbox console. "Few studios have shaped the first-person shooter genre as much as id Software," Sharma wrote. "Slaughter Mode comes to Doom: The Dark Ages - Revelations on Monday, and the team is already working on its next game." "Already" might be stretching it a bit: The studio's previous game, Doom: The Dark Ages , came out well over a year ago, although the Revelations expansion only dropped in July.
